gloss: workaholic; person who lives for work

definitions.gloss: workaholic; person who lives for work
definitions.explanation: Someone whose life centers on their job, often at the expense of family and private life. Usually mildly critical or rueful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仕事人間|しごとにんげん}だ。
{仕事人間|しごとにんげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He's a workaholic and has almost no time with his family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧{仕事人間|しごとにんげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧わからず⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: My workaholic husband has retired and doesn't know what to do with himself every day.

notes:
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (work) + ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧ (person). The type is familiar from postwar company culture, together with the image of the father who is never home.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {会社人間|かいしゃにんげん}: company man; devoted to the company rather than to work itself
- ワーカホリック: workaholic; loanword, more clinical in tone
- {企業戦士|きぎょうせんし}: corporate warrior; the hard-driving salaryman of the boom years
